definitions.explanation: A widely used vegetable in Japanese cooking with tightly packed, pale green to white leaves. A staple ingredient in hot pot dishes ({鍋|なべ}), stir-fries, pickles, and soups, especially popular in winter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{白菜|はくさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I put Chinese cabbage in the hot pot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{白菜|はくさい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{甘|あま}く→甘い：00617_amai⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
examples.english: In winter, Chinese cabbage becomes sweet and delicious.

examples.japanese: {白菜|はくさい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{豚肉|ぶたにく}→豚肉：02956_butaniku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ミルフィーユ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{材料|ざいりょう}→材料：02831_zairyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交互|こうご}→交互：16076_kougo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねる→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{作|つく}れる→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦レシピ→レシピ：07157_reshipi⟧だ。
examples.english: Mille-feuille hot pot with Chinese cabbage and pork is a popular recipe that can be made easily by just layering the ingredients alternately.

notes:
USAGE:
One of the most common vegetables in Japanese home cooking, especially during the colder months. {白菜|はくさい} is the quintessential ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧ (hot pot) ingredient and is also widely used for ⟦{漬物|つけもの}→漬物：04938_tsukemono⟧ (pickles). The Korean equivalent, kimchi (⟦キムチ→キムチ：10838_kimuchi⟧), also uses this vegetable.

ETYMOLOGY:
Literally "white vegetable" — {白|はく} (white) + {菜|さい} (vegetable). Named for the white stems and pale inner leaves.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {白菜|はくさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{漬物|つけもの}→漬物：04938_tsukemono⟧: Chinese cabbage pickles
- {白菜|はくさい}⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧: Chinese cabbage hot pot
- {白菜|はくさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: cut Chinese cabbage
- {白菜|はくさい}⟦キムチ→キムチ：10838_kimuchi⟧: Chinese cabbage kimchi
